Usage: gcc [options] file...
Options:
  --help                   Display help
  --version                Display compiler version
  -E                       Preprocess input
  -S                       Produce assembly
  -c                       Compile input
  -o <file>                Select output path
  -std=<standard>          Select language standard
  -I <directory>           Add an include directory
  -Wa,<options>            Pass options to the assembler
  -Wp,<options>            Pass options to the preprocessor
  -Wl,<options>            Pass options to the linker
  -###                     Show quoted compiler commands
